info.name: App Store Cards
info.summary: Rich previews and search for Nextcloud App Store links
info.description:
Paste a link to an app from the Nextcloud App Store into Talk, Text or any other app with link previews, and it becomes a card with the app's screenshot, summary, latest version, supported Nextcloud versions, rating and categories.
- **Link previews** wherever Nextcloud shows them, including on public share pages - **Unified search:** find App Store apps from the search in the header - **Smart Picker:** insert a link to an app while you write - **Privacy:** your server fetches the catalogue once a day and keeps a copy of each screenshot, so people viewing a card never contact the App Store. Admins can turn screenshots off. - **Accessibility:** cards work with a keyboard and screen readers, and follow each user's theme
After installation, the catalogue fills at the next cron run, or straight away with `occ appstore_cards:refresh`.
info.author: Oliver Anyanwu
